question: Can a bounded common-reference correction in the final0.5s before source stop change wheel/body response and improve subsequent tracking at unchanged task/stop constraints?
scientific_scope: Clear-box, known source stops6/8s; classical authority probe, not a TD3 comparison, obstacle experiment or hardware validation.

intervention.before_tail: Identical inherited classical scheduled request and projection
intervention.active_predicate: Healthy source/permission/history, nominal steady; stop-0.5 <= decision_time < stop
intervention.at_or_after_source_stop: Requested residual=0; retain inherited zero-source priority and baseline deceleration
intervention.information: Current causal source/health/history and the same declared stop plan, no GT/contact input

task.note: Fixed 14 s task, terminal deadline (not external truncation). Two fresh launches are descriptive repeats, not exact-state pairs or independent learner seeds. All thresholds are sim engineering proposals.

compatibility.reason: Tail eligibility/current-window semantics differ; do not reuse common103 checkpoint ABI merely because a vector dimension matches.

measurement.primary: Integral of squared independent nominal body velocity tracking error
measurement.window_clock: measurement task timestamps; do not assign body sample time from preceding decision index
secondary: source-zero to inherited quiet-condition onset interval
requested -> windowed -> accepted -> driver executed reference
measurement.input_checks: Retain native replay, source-clock/GT window support and inherited cadence/timestamp gates; no metric merging or spike removal

proposed_decision_rules.scope: Research screening proposals, not application tolerances or significance claims
proposed_decision_rules.estimand: For each tail sign and stop separately: mean of2 within-block candidate/control ratios minus1; report both signs, absolute deltas and all blocks. Zero denominator -> unknown.
proposed_decision_rules.go: Useful wheel/body contrast, >=5% primary reduction in both blocks/both stops and all3 grids; full-route RMS regression<=2%, quiet-onset regression<=0.1s and inherited task/stop/path gates pass. Advance only classical tuning/confirmation.
proposed_decision_rules.no_go: Reference differs but no repeatable useful outcome, or outcome constraints fail: retain historical classical for this envelope.
proposed_decision_rules.unknown: Measurement/approach mismatch, grid-sensitive or inconsistent effects: close screen, keep failures, no automatic sample-size increase.
proposed_decision_rules.learning: No TD3 release from this screen; require a residual need beyond a strong classical candidate and a separate training protocol.

prerequisites: Isolated versioned adapter/runner not implemented by this draft
Neutral-arm parity and stateful projection/stop/health tests
Metadata/cadence/driver execution conformance with the inherited readiness contract
Disk and wall-cap review before any release
Separate explicit attempt allocation and decision-rule review
causality_limits: Fresh launches with paired requested seeds are not exact-state branches
Two blocks are a descriptive screen, not training seeds or a powered generalization test
Before-tail command equality is required; physical differences are retained and can make causal verdict unknown
Late14s error association is not proof that this bounded tail action can improve it
